title: City search is case-sensitive

issue.title: Searching for lowercase 'london' returns no results
issue.body: The /search endpoint only matches when the query capitalisation exactly matches the city name. Searching 'london' or 'BER' returns an empty list. Search should be case-insensitive while still matching on prefix.
issue.repro_steps: GET /search?q=l returns an empty list but GET /search?q=L returns London and Lisbon.
issue.expected_behavior: Prefix matching ignores case. An empty query still returns no results.

expected_root_cause: search_cities uses str.startswith with the raw query, which is case-sensitive; both sides need normalising.
